difficulty_why: Gmail full mailbox access requires Google OAuth restricted scope verification and a mandatory annual third-party CASA Tier 2 security assessment. The review process requires weeks of turnaround and paid third-party audit fees.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Enabling the Gmail API in Google Cloud Console, setting up the OAuth consent screen with External user type, and generating Web application client credentials for developer testing.

launch_time.label: 4-8 weeks
launch_time.text: Completing Search Console domain verification, producing the consent demo video, passing Google OAuth verification, and completing the annual third-party CASA security assessment.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Display your own brand name, application logo, and verified domain to end users on the OAuth consent screen once verified, rather than Composio's generic consent screen.

own_app_reasons.label: Scope customization
own_app_reasons.text: Select and justify the exact set of Gmail and profile scopes required for your specific AI agent features.

app_type.label: Web application
app_type.text: OAuth 2.0 Client ID with application type 'Web application' in Google Cloud Console, configured with 'External' user type on the OAuth consent screen so any Google account holder can connect.

prerequisites.label: Google Cloud project
prerequisites.text: A Google account and an active Google Cloud Platform project with the Gmail API enabled.

prerequisites.label: Verified domain ownership
prerequisites.text: Ownership of your application domain verified in Google Search Console by a project owner or editor.

prerequisites.label: Public Privacy Policy and Terms
prerequisites.text: A public privacy policy hosted on the verified domain disclosing compliance with Google API Services User Data Policy and Limited Use requirements.

prerequisites.label: Demo video
prerequisites.text: A publicly accessible YouTube or Google Drive video URL demonstrating the full OAuth consent screen flow and in-app usage of requested scopes.

prerequisites.label: Third-party CASA assessment
prerequisites.text: An annual Cloud Application Security Assessment (CASA Tier 2) performed by an authorized security assessor for restricted scope usage.

prerequisites.label: Contact email addresses
prerequisites.text: A user support email and developer contact email address configured on the OAuth consent screen.

steps.label: Enable Gmail API
steps.text: Navigate to APIs & Services > Enabled APIs & services in Google Cloud Console, click + ENABLE APIS AND SERVICES, search for Gmail API, and click Enable.

steps.label: Select User Type
steps.text: Navigate to APIs & Services > OAuth consent screen in Google Cloud Console, select User Type 'External', and click Create.

steps.label: Configure OAuth consent branding
steps.text: Enter your App name, select a User support email, add your verified Authorized domain, enter Developer contact email addresses, and click Save and Continue.

steps.label: Add OAuth Scopes
steps.text: Click Add or Remove Scopes, select or manually paste each required scope, click Update, then click Save and Continue.

steps.label: Create OAuth Client ID
steps.text: Navigate to APIs & Services > Credentials, click + Create Credentials, select OAuth client ID, and set Application type to 'Web application'.

steps.label: Set Authorized Redirect URI
steps.text: Under Authorized redirect URIs, click + ADD URI, paste 'https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add', and click Create.

steps.label: Retrieve OAuth Credentials
steps.text: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret displayed in the confirmation dialog to configure your custom OAuth credentials in Composio.

steps.label: Submit for OAuth Verification
steps.text: On the OAuth consent screen tab, click Publish App and Submit for Verification, then submit your demo video link and scope justifications for Google review and CASA assessment.

fields.label: Scope justification
fields.value: Explain end-user necessity for each requested scope

approval.label: When required
approval.text: OAuth verification is required whenever an External app requests sensitive or restricted scopes like https://mail.google.com/ or serves users outside your Google Workspace organization.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Google verifies domain ownership via Search Console, privacy policy Limited Use compliance, a demo video demonstrating scope usage, and a third-party CASA Tier 2 security assessment.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Initial brand verification takes 2-3 business days, while restricted scope verification including the CASA security assessment typically takes several weeks.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Google verification is free, but third-party CASA security assessments conducted by Google-approved assessors are paid by the developer, typically ranging from $150 to $3,000+.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Rejections stem from missing Limited Use disclosure in the privacy policy, demo videos omitting the client ID or OAuth flow, unverified domains, or requesting scopes beyond minimum necessity.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: External users encounter an 'Unverified app' security screen, refresh tokens expire after 7 days in test mode, and Workspace administrators may block unapproved external apps.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: In testing mode, only 100 explicitly invited test accounts can connect; unverified production apps face a lifetime cap of 100 external user authorizations.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Tokens expire every 7 days in testing status, external accounts see interstitial security warnings, and access is capped at 100 users before verification.

pitfalls.label: Restricted scope triggers mandatory security assessment
pitfalls.text: The scope https://mail.google.com/ is classified as restricted and triggers mandatory restricted scope verification and an annual third-party security assessment.

pitfalls.label: 100-user cap on unverified apps
pitfalls.text: Unverified apps requesting sensitive or restricted scopes are restricted to a lifetime cap of 100 new users before sign-in is disabled.

pitfalls.label: 7-day refresh token expiry in test mode
pitfalls.text: OAuth refresh tokens issued while the app is in Testing mode expire after 7 days, breaking persistent agent connections until the app is published.

pitfalls.label: Domain ownership verification in Google Search Console
pitfalls.text: Authorized domains listed on the OAuth consent screen must be verified by a Google Cloud project owner or editor using Google Search Console.

pitfalls.label: Prohibition on AI/ML foundation model training
pitfalls.text: Google Workspace user data may not be used to create, train, or improve machine learning or foundational AI models under Google API policies.

pitfalls.label: Demo video language and scope requirements
pitfalls.text: The verification demo video must show the full OAuth consent flow in English, visibly display the OAuth client ID, and demonstrate how each requested scope is used.

support.label: OAuth Verification Support Email
support.text: Reply directly to verification emails sent by Google's Trust & Safety / OAuth app review team for your project.

support.label: Google Cloud Console Help Center
support.text: Google Cloud documentation and support articles covering OAuth consent screen setup and verification.

support.label: Google Workspace Developers Support
support.text: Documentation and technical guides for Gmail API authorization and protocol workflows.

email_subject: Inquiry regarding Gmail API OAuth Verification & CASA Tier 2 Assessment for [App Name]
email_body:
Hello Google OAuth Verification Team,

We are developing an AI agent application that enables users to manage and summarize their emails via the Gmail API, connecting through Composio.

We are preparing our Google Cloud project for OAuth verification and have a few questions regarding our submission:
1. Our integration requests the restricted scope 'https://mail.google.com/' along with basic profile and read-only contact scopes. Can you confirm the current CASA Tier 2 security assessment process and approved assessor list for this tier?
2. Are there any preliminary steps required in Google Search Console before our demo video and scope justifications are submitted for review?
3. What is the current turnaround time for restricted scope review once our CASA assessment documentation is provided?

Project Details:
- Project ID: [Your Google Cloud Project ID]
- Application Name: [Your Application Name]
- Redirect URI: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Company]
